_readme: AUTHORED. One line per room: the argument Palle ruled it makes, in Palle's words as close as a line allows. The Red Thread page shows a ruling on the room's card, and a room that was SPLIT in the triage counts as decided once it has one. Regenerate the page with tools/red_thread_page.py.

Point_Triangle_Context.argument: Everything is built by triangles. Rigidity is why the triangle is the unit, not the argument; the angle stays a hint, and wavefunctions names it.

Primitives_Polythedra.argument: The first solid is a corner: three faces meeting at a point, the trihedron, practised by shifting its faces.

Point_Animatedcube.argument: The cube is twelve triangles and a net, and it is what the whole museum is made of. Crates and cube props belong here: a world without composition yet, and the text says so.

Primitives_Ignorance.argument: The Platonic set, then resolution producing form (a low-res sphere is a prism), then the capsule: an odd segment count has no centre of symmetry, so the far side cannot be derived from the near. The anti-Platonic primitive, shipping in the standard menu under the plainest name.

Primitives_Portals.argument: The finite never arrives: an n-gon approaches the circle and does not reach it. Achilles is already standing in the room.

Primitives_Melencolia.argument: Stuck inside the mathematical universe with every tool in hand, and the desire that runs the other way: abstraction as escape or as truth, wanted for itself.
